subject: Sales→CS: PillarTide kickoff / acceptance criteria and proposed go-live cadence
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Anna Rinehart <anna@pillartide.com>, itops@pillartide.com
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Jan 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: PillarTide contract signed — next steps for onboarding

Anna / Team — thanks again for signing. Quick handoff note so CS can pick up execution: 

Summary:
- Product: Hosted Redwood API (text generation + embeddings) + Dedicated routing for PHI pipelines.
- Committed capacity: 2 reserved GPU slots (m/throughput profile) starting Feb 1.
- Key success metric: <1s median token latency for critical endpoints; integration test pass for ingestion pipelines.

Attachments: SOW (signed) and MA Plan v1 — high level timeline & responsibilities.

Proposed kickoff: week of Jan 19 — we suggested Wed Jan 21 for a 60-min kickoff (agenda below). Please confirm availability.

What I need from CS (Ben / Marissa):
- Take ownership of onboarding and run the kickoff.
- Confirm internal owner (technical lead + PM).
- Validate acceptance criteria below and escalate any procurement/KMS items before Jan 18.

Acceptance criteria (initial):
- Test ingest of 5000 de-identified records into a staging endpoint.
- End-to-end auth working with PillarTide KMS (key escrow question below).
- 2x simple prompt templates validated against their test set with pass/fail thresholds.

Open items for procurement/security:
- PillarTide requested customer-managed KMS; legal signoff on responsibilities is pending (see SOW, section 4.3).
- Data retention: PillarTide wants 30-day KV cache retention for debugging. Need to confirm feasibility with infra.

Kickoff agenda (proposed):
1) Intros & roles (10m)
2) Scope, timelines & milestones (10m)
3) Security/procurement checklist (15m)
4) Technical intake — data formats, API keys, test dataset (15m)
5) Next steps & owners (10m)

Thanks — I’ll loop back after Ben confirms owners.

—
Monica Patel
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com
Attachment: SOW_PillarTide_signed.docx (SOW, signed)
Attachment: Pillar_Tide_MA_Plan_v1.pdf (milestone plan)

Best,

Subject: Re: PillarTide contract signed — CS owner + pre-kickoff checklist

Thanks Monica — I’ll own the onboarding for Redwood. Marissa will be PM for implementation.

Initial plan & owners:
- CS Lead (overall): Ben Carter — ben.carter@redwood.com
- Implementation PM: Marissa Cole — marissa.cole@redwood.com
- Integration SE (tech lead): Karthik Iyer — karthik.iyer@redwood.com

Pre-kickoff checklist (items to complete by Jan 18):
1) Confirm KMS model (customer-managed vs Redwood-managed) and whether we need an HSM config. (Owner: Marissa / Legal)
2) Provide staging dataset details and access method (S3 presigned URL / secure FTP). (Owner: PillarTide)
3) Generate service account credentials and test API key with limited scope (Owner: PillarTide + Karthik to validate)
4) Draft integration runbook for authentication and retry/backoff guidance; I’ll put a skeleton doc into the Drive link. (Owner: Ben)
5) Confirm go/no-go criteria for canary (Owner: Ben + PillarTide PM)

Acceptance criteria (refined):
- Successful ingest of sample dataset into staging and a run of the provided validation script with >90% pass rate on fidelity checks.
- KMS integration validated by a test encrypt/decrypt round-trip from PillarTide systems.
- Canary traffic limited to <5% of production capacity during first 48 hours.

Notes / risks:
- If KMS remains unresolved by Jan 18 we should default to Redwood-managed keys for staging to keep timeline. Procurement needs to be aware of that fallback.
- We should confirm token and request rate expectations in writing before go-live to avoid throttling surprises.

I’ll draft the kickoff invite for Jan 21 10:00am PT and share calendar + meeting notes.

—
Ben Carter
Principal Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com

Subject: Re: PillarTide contract signed — technical intake notes

Looping in a few technical intake items ahead of the kickoff: 

Tech intake:
- API surface: they will use text-generation endpoints and embeddings for search. We need to confirm max sequence lengths and any streaming requirements.
- Test accounts: please ask PillarTide to provision a staging API key that is rate-limited to 50 rps for the canary.
- Data formats: ingestion will be newline-delimited JSON; provide schema sample (I’ll add a sample payload to Drive).

Security/ops asks:
- KMS: if they insist on customer-managed keys we need a key rotation window and an admin contact. Does PillarTide have HSM-backed KMS? If yes, we need their public key for initial enrollment.
- Audit logs: PillarTide requested 90 days of API audit retention; our standard is 30 days — we need a decision for the SOW addendum.

Test artifacts: I’ll prepare the validation scripts (ingest validator + output fidelity checks) and upload to the onboarding folder by EOD Jan 15. Marissa — can you own coordinating the test dataset ingest with Anna?

—
Karthik Iyer
Senior Integration SE, Redwood Inference
